conditions.text: A5 Q2=A sequential runtime freeze; approval binds policy+code+initial seeds only, not future designs.
Before any solver start for a design: A1 FreezeAPI arm-blind K=10 discovery + <=40 builds per target family -> two families frozen -> PRE SHA -> append-only record -> then start.
A1 evaluator MODE_RUNTIME must verify the design record exists and both family SHAs match; otherwise 0 start.
One freeze per design shared by all six arms; no recompute, no family picking, no overwrite.
Any unreachable family -> entire design VOID for every arm; no single-arm discard and no single-family primary.
End of run: final pair manifest + complete append-only log for A5 review.
Initial three LHS designs are zero-physical pre-frozen and exactly listed in the initial manifest.
If A1 cannot satisfy the runtime checks, fall back to B (split windows); A2 must not re-implement freeze.

The single canonical solver_attempts.jsonl writer is the A1 TwoFamilyEvaluator (event=start/end rows); A1 solver_ledger.SolverLedger is not invoked; A2 only reads/pairs by case_id and never writes a second schema.
No retry: any non-SOLVED result -> S2 stop; timeout is a charged start, no retry.
Single seed=42 descriptive only; no winner; no optimizer PASS; cross-family numeric comparison forbidden.

A1 evaluator v1.2 real path is implemented and verified by the A1 probe v3 (10/10 SECURE, physical=0); no main-batch real start has occurred yet (R1/R2/R3/R4 preflights are historical, excluded from E1-E6 and counted toward the cumulative caps; see R1-R2-R3-R4-HIST-01), and the first main-batch real start requires this signed approval, A5 C-P2AV2R7-02 PASS and a Lead GO. Before R7 the actual cumulative consumption is 47 starts / 341 internal, counted toward the caps and disclosed per R1-R2-R3-R4-HIST-01; R7 is the last execution attempt and the first batch that may execute the 384-slot main matrix.
Physical validation remains NOT_VALIDATED; fuel_burn_kg is null.

This approval governs only batch_id {{BATCH_ID}} / run_id {{RUN_ID}}; the approved plan bytes and all bound identities must not change after signature; any byte change voids this approval (Lead must re-sign).

After signature A2 must run the post-approval dry-run in this run dir and report DRY_RUN_OK with approval_sha256/plan_sha256, 386 planned starts / 2702 planned internal / 451 max starts and 0 physical starts, then wait for a Lead GO before the first solver start.
Window: no solver start before {{WINDOW_START_UTC}} or after {{WINDOW_END_UTC}}; token {{WINDOW_TOKEN}} must be present both at approval top level and in approval.window.token.

Physical starts are capped at 451 (386 planned: 2 B2 preflight + 384 main arm slots; 64 reserve) and internal solver cases at 3157 (2702 planned); every start must be ledgered in the single canonical run_dir/solver_attempts.jsonl written by the A1 TwoFamilyEvaluator event ledger (event=start/end, keyed by case_id); on exhaustion the batch stops, never retries, never starts without a ledger row. Before R7 the actual cumulative consumption is 47 starts / 341 internal (39/285 prior + R1 2/14 + R2 2/14 + R3 2/14 + R4 2/14); with the R7 plan it is 433 starts / 3043 internal, still within 451 / 3157 (headroom 18 / 114).

Preflight runs first: only PRE-01 and PRE-02 replay cases are authorized; each bills exactly 1 start / 7 internal; any non-PASS_BYTE outcome (byte mismatched polar, missing approval bundle bytes, spawn failure) stops the batch (S1) before the 384-slot main matrix; no retry, no unilateral numeric tolerance.

Per-design runtime freeze must precede any solver start for that design: A1 FreezeAPI K=10 arm-blind discovery, exactly two families, <=40 forced builds per family, PRE SHA verification, append-only hash-chained record; any failure voids the design for all six arms (0 start) and no single-family fallback is allowed.

B2 frozen-geometry waiver is approved only for this batch/run: frozen .vspgeom/.vkey bytes are batch-scoped, must be generated by the bound A1 builder/FreezeAPI, must never be reused from P1/P1C/P1R runs or across runs, and every start must re-verify the frozen SHA before spawn.

A5 must complete the post-execution independent audit of the ledger/batch summary/manifest before any result is reported as an optimizer outcome; A5 signs continuation/result only within its stated scope.

No optimizer ranking, no statistical significance claim, no winner, no fuel burn, no aerodynamic PASS, no 12D_ACTIVE validation, and no physical validation may be claimed from this single-seed descriptive batch; fuel_burn_kg remains null and physical_validation_status remains NOT_VALIDATED.

Preflight evaluator isolation: PRE-01 (design 8bd5a6c7c8311938, 543x472) and PRE-02 (design bc52a54ecefaac4c, 483x418) are distinct cells; each preflight case must use a fresh A1 TwoFamilyEvaluator instance with independent _seen_cells. PRE-03 is retired and must not run. Reusing one instance (DUPLICATE_DESIGN_FAMILY_CELL) or asking A1 to waive dedupe is not authorized.

Preflight PASS requires the actual polar SHA to equal approval.replay_bundles.cases polar SHA (PASS_BYTE). PASS_NUMERIC (7 rows max rel <= 1e-9, same mesh) is accepted only with prior written Lead and A5 acceptance; otherwise S1 stops the batch and the main matrix is NOT_RUN. A2 alone may not accept numeric equivalence.

Per-row backend must be explicit and non-inheritable: main-batch rows REAL_VSPAERO; preflight rows REPLAY_B2 with preflight=true. A3/A5 audit row-level backend evidence; run-level inheritance is not allowed.

This approval binds policy, code and initial seeds, not future designs. Every runtime design must be arm-blind frozen and appended to the hash-chained append-only log before any solver start for that design; final_run_manifest_required=true and the final manifest must be complete. A design may not be frozen or replaced after its first solver start.
A2 executes; A1 is read-only witness. Only the Lead may authorize continuation or results release; A5's result signature scope is limited to its stated audit scope.

Any deviation (protocol, retry, accounting mismatch, preflight failure, ledger gap, or design re-freeze) must stop the batch and be disclosed as an incident; no result may be reported as an optimizer outcome before A5's independent post-execution audit.

Execution protocol for the A1 single-writer ledger: exactly one canonical run_dir/solver_attempts.jsonl; exactly one evaluator instance alive at a time (each preflight case, then each main arm, constructed in scope and closed in finally; six evaluators must not be pre-constructed). The ledger must never be deleted, truncated or recreated; a stale lock is a fail-closed incident and must never be silently removed.
Per-arm evaluator max_starts is the arm budget (or the global remainder), never 451; A2 independently tracks global starts from the canonical ledger and stops at 451.

Case identity: every start/end pair is keyed by case_id, which must be non-empty and globally unique; start/end pairing and start counts are audited by case_id with event=start. attempt_id is informational only and may repeat across arms; A3/A5 must key on case_id.

Sref(x) must be resolved and validated (zero-physical, from x12) and written into the case record before evaluator.evaluate is called; an unresolved Sref means 0 starts and a fail-closed ExecutorRefused.

After an evaluator close and only with no live ledger writer, an orphan start may be repaired by appending an EXECUTOR_EXCEPTION end row (no refund); no end row may be fabricated without a recorded start; the normal path must never have A2 write the ledger directly.

Run end must call A1 build_final_run_manifest(..., allow_invalid=false); an invalid or refused final manifest is a failed batch with stop_report, never COMPLETED; batch_summary must record the final manifest SHA.

Before the first start, A2 must verify the initial_designs_manifest file SHA and its approval binding, and recompute design_hash from x12 for initial designs 15/16/17; any mismatch is fail-closed with zero starts.

Internal solver cases must be derived from evaluations/records, not from the evaluator event ledger (event rows do not carry internal_solver_cases); batch_summary must report ledger_starts and record_internal_cases separately and must never substitute 0 for a missing internal count.

If preflight fails, A2 must close the evaluator, repair orphan starts only after the writer is closed, recompute physical starts from the canonical ledger, write stop_report, and only then write batch_summary; no summary may report 0 physical while the ledger has unpaired starts.
